execution.measurement_recipe: Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time' -SampleInterval 5 -MaxSamples 13; skip the first sample, average the 12 retained samples, multiply by 32 logical processors, and compare against 0.75 busy cores.
execution.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$started = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$samples = @(Get-Counter -Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time' -SampleInterval 5 -MaxSamples 13 | ForEach-Object { $_.CounterSamples })
$values = @($samples | Select-Object -Skip 1 | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.CookedValue })
if ($values.Count -ne 12) { throw "expected 12 retained samples, got $($values.Count)" }
$logical = [int](Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).NumberOfLogicalProcessors
$mean = [double](($values | Measure-Object -Average).Average)
$busy = $mean * $logical / 100.0
[pscustomobject]@{ started_utc = $started; completed_utc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); counter = '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'; interval_seconds = 5; requested_samples = $samples.Count; skipped_initial = 1; retained_samples = $values.Count; logical_processors = $logical; percent_samples = $values; mean_percent = $mean; busy_logical_cores = $busy; guard_limit = 0.75; guard_pass = ($busy -le 0.75) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
